notes.title: Video Editor Tycoon Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
FIX
- Coffee is now the first item on the investment list
- When you play again when you return to the menu, time will no longer be stopped
- Saving the amount of tasks when leveling up with the character through investment
- Fixed the issue of the employee working on the posterior index, as he was not disabling isTasking
- Fixed the issue of saving the employee's isTasking prior to what was subsequently dismissed as true
- Adjustments to load the save with the cost information to download and also how many tasks are being done
- Warning screen appearing when the employee is fired or resigns

And that's all guys, I hope you have less problems with this version and anything you want to add to the game, contact our facebook page, see you later.

notes.title: Video Editor Tycoon Version 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
Hello guys, this is the first time I’ve done this, so I’ll explain about some that will be fixed in the future and others that I’ve fixed.

In the game, there is a link to our facebook page, where you can report problems and suggestions directly to developers, and before you forget, I ask everyone to add the tycoon marker (or "magnata" in portuguese).

FIX
- when the game paused, the music didn’t continue, but now the problem is solved.
- the achievement of using half of the items was fixed, as I was counting on the achievement in the wrong way, there are still 5 items to be inserted in order for you to platinize the game.

TODO
- when you want to start over and press a new game, time stops once and for all.


if you want to keep in touch with the developers, follow us on the social network:
https://www.facebook.com/VideoEditorTycoonOfficial/
